what_is_new: shenko_store::session_events: committed raw-event search/list/read with CJK substring (LIKE) plus FTS5 where it applies, bounded previews, ascending seq order and a rebuild path from committed events

shenko_exec_host::history_task: native `history.query/v1` child (op search|list|read, deny_unknown_fields, bounded limit) that freezes its exact input, resolves the original operation on retry and never re-dispatches a second read

loop_runner: a late raw-history or execution-only commit between projection and seal now yields ResnapshotRequired and a fresh S0 instead of a dead subject; the frozen request is never silently replayed

cargo_test_targets: shenko-store (units, cognition_replication, identity_profile, memory_search, raw_session_writer, session_event_search, store_roundtrip)
the two model harnesses skip without an endpoint
verification.note: the previous head 1a15d9b did not compile: the final S0 test used ShenkoError without importing it; the merge repairs the import and the test now runs

native_replay.data: retained dataset with 3 committed S1 steps, 8 raw events and one planned step; the pre-fix binary stopped there with `S0 execution evidence/source commit changed`
native_replay.path_binding: the dataset records absolute home/memory mounts, so the copy was bind-mounted at its recorded path /tmp/shenko-history-runtime-923vzb2_/data for the run and unmounted afterwards; no bytes were written outside the persistent copy under build/c09-native-replay-20261027
native_replay.provider: scripted OpenAI-compatible fixture on 127.0.0.1:18901; three authored responses then a fixed continuation message

scripted_search.matched_of_total: 5 of 306 raw events; later steps do not contain the term
scripted_search.previews: bounded data_preview per event, full data only via op=read

bounds.provider: scripted fixture, not a model run: nothing here measures model behaviour
bounds.scale: the fixture keeps answering, so the run produced ~295 idle continuations; only the fact of sealing, the CJK search and the read path are observed
bounds.ui: the run used the real binary and store but the Web UI was not driven; timeline rendering is not claimed
bounds.packages: this is a C09 slice (raw history retrieval + S0 reprojection), not complete C09: research workers, PMA, reset-to-best, external memory portability and space handling remain open

reproducer: cargo test -p shenko-store -p shenko-subject -p shenko-exec-host -p shenko --no-fail-fast --offline --locked
